market_summary: Weekend; no new trading since the Fri Nov 20 rout. Final closes confirmed a deep chip selloff: NVDA -14%, MU -14%, MRVL -12%, TSM -9.5%, ENPH -11%, while megacaps fell 3-6% and RKT rose 4%. GPU rents stayed firm through it, so the damage is in equity pricing, not compute demand. The Fed is still priced for a Dec 9 hike; final UMich and fresh FedWatch odds were not verified this run.

AMZN.reason: Closed Fri down 4.1% with megacaps; no company news, AWS thesis intact.

AXOS.reason: Down 2.2% Fri; forward PE ~8.4, little AI exposure.

BABA.reason: Down 2.7% Fri; forward PE ~9.6, cloud growth thesis unchanged.

ENPH.reason: Down 10.7% Fri with no company news; hike pricing weighs on residential solar.

FIGR.reason: Down 7.7% Fri alongside crypto weakness; wait for stabilisation.

GOOGL.reason: Down 2.7% Fri, far less than chips; cheapest megacap held, Anthropic stake marked to market.

LDI.reason: Down 17% Fri, listing-compliance risk and no forward earnings; weakest position.

META.reason: Down 5.9% Fri on AI capex fears; no company-specific news.

MRVL.reason: Down 11.7% Fri after this week's downgrade; earnings Dec 1 US time are the next test.

MU.reason: Down 13.9% Fri, about 22% over the week; forward PE ~3.4. Don't sell into panic.

NFLX.reason: Down 3% Fri, little AI exposure; relative ballast.

NVDA.reason: Down 14% Fri to a 52-week low on CEO exit and export subpoena; forward PE ~8.7 prices a lot of fear.

RKT.reason: Up 4.3% Fri as the 10yr eased under 5%; rare green holding.

TSM.reason: Down 9.5% Fri as Taiwan sold off; foundry position unchanged.

STRIPE.reason: No new round or tender reported; mark unchanged.

OPENAI.reason: No new round found; last tender Aug at $852B. Anthropic's post-IPO slide is the public comp to watch.

headlines: Fri closes confirmed: NVDA -14%, MU -14%, MRVL -12%, ENPH -11%, TSM -9.5%; RKT +4%.
